text:
Jordan Park: Quick note — on tablet/narrow desktop the Prompt Sets run list stacks and the regression diff preview gets pushed off-canvas. Screenshot in thread. :point_down:
Lina Gomez: I noticed that too. The preview takes the full width instead of becoming a drawer. Feels bad for scanning many runs.
Priya Shah: For keyboard/screen reader users we need a persistent open affordance. Maybe an accordion per run with `aria-expanded` + a hidden summary? e.g. "Run #128 — 8 tests, 2 changed" in the list item.
Samir Patel: Copy thought: primary button says "Approve changes" which is scary when applied to multiple runs. Suggest "Review & approve" or "Confirm approval"?
Lina Gomez: +1 to "Review & approve". Also change modal secondary action from "Cancel" to "Back to review" — reduces accidental dismiss confusion.
Jordan Park: Accessibility: when opening the diff the focus should move into the diff area, ESC should close and restore focus to the originating row. Right now focus stays put which breaks keyboard flow.
design-bot: Contrast scan: `.diff-flag` color ratio 3.8:1 — needs to be >=4.5:1 for normal text. Also flagged interactive focus ring missing on `.run-row .more-actions`.
Priya Shah: For status we should avoid color-only indicators. Add a small icon and `sr-only` text like "3 changed tests". I'll propose a darker orange token and toggle bold for small text.
Samir Patel: UX flow question: bulk approve — do we show a combined modal that summarizes all diffs or require reviewing each?
Lina Gomez: Modal digest is fine but include inline mini-previews and a "Review individually" link. That caters to both fast and cautious users.
Jordan Park: Layout proposal: two-column grid on wide screens (runs | preview), on narrow screens the preview becomes a slide-up drawer (`role=dialog`) that animates with transform. Drawer should be dismissible via close button and ESC.
Priya Shah: Also ensure run list rows have an accessible summary attribute — `aria-describedby` pointing to a short line for SRs.
Samir Patel: Dev note: can we get the run list API to return `run.summary` and `run.a11y_meta` so we don't need per-row fetches? That would eliminate extra round trips.
Lina Gomez: I'll update the mocks and props. Jordan, can you drop a short keyboard-only prototype (keystrokes and focus order)?
Jordan Park: Will do — uploading a Loom + flow diagram. Also added a small CSS hint: keep the drawer animation on transform for perf: `transform: translateY(100%) -> translateY(0)` and `will-change: transform`.
design-bot: Added checklist to PR template: focus management, ARIA labels for dynamic panels, keyboard shortcuts documented, contrast verified.
Priya Shah: Micro-copy: change CTA to "Review & approve", secondary to "Back to review", bulk modal shows exact counts like "8 runs selected — 14 changed tests total".
Samir Patel: Interaction nit: failing tests should surface an inline pill "1 failing" that anchors directly to the failing test in the preview.
Lina Gomez: Agree. Also on mobile the drawer should be full-height with a grab handle and `aria-label="Run preview dialog"`.
Jordan Park: I'll file a follow-up ticket covering API contract + keyboard flow + copy + contrast token. Thanks team. :tada:
Lina Gomez: Sweet — merging waits for mocks + API.
Priya Shah: I'll put together the contrast variants and SR text suggestions.
Samir Patel: Holding PR. Ping when mocks live.
Jordan Park: Done — Loom + keyboard diagram uploaded.
Lina Gomez: Thanks all.
